newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish ARR agency raises grain procurement prices.
newsitem.headline: Polish ARR agency raises grain procurement prices.

text.p: Poland's Food Market Agency (ARR), the government's agriculture market regulator, said it will raise its grain procurement prices on Thursday to fill gaps in its reserves.
"The ARR decided to raise its procurement grain prices because the agency is buying less grain than planned at current prices," spokesman Stanislaw Myslinski said on Wednesday.
Myslinski said ARR had bought only six percent of its planned 1996 grain purchase of 300,000 tonnes.
ARR will raise its wheat procurement price by 80 zlotys to 600 zlotys/tonne, its rye price by 40 zlotys to 380 zlotys/tonne and barley by 70 to 480 zlotys/tonne.
The ARR had also decided to double to amount of intervention pork sales to lower the rising price of pork.
The agency sold 6,200 tonnes of pork in August 11-20.
